headings: Why BPM Exists
paragraphs:
Most natural deodorants come with tradeoffs: 
weak performance, irritation, plastic packaging, or inflated pricing. 
BPM was built to do better. Reliable odour control, simple ingredients, smooth application, and a metal tube instead of the usual plastic stick, without inflated pricing.

paragraphs: Deodorant has one job: control odour and feel good on skin. BPM goes on smoothly, absorbs quickly, and leaves no waxy or sticky residue. It works whether your skin is dry or just out of the shower.
Every ingredient in BPM has a job. No baking soda. No waxes. No unnecessary fillers. Just a simple, effective formula designed to work with your skin, not against it.

headings: TRANSPARENT PRICING.
No green tax or mystery markup. A transparent look at where your money goes.
paragraphs: We price BPM at $23.99 to cover what it takes to make the product properly, package it responsibly, ship it thoughtfully, support discounts, give back, and keep BPM running. We keep pricing consistent across our website and Amazon, even though Amazon takes a larger share through fulfilment, fees, advertising, and freight. Buying directly from BPM keeps more of each sale with us, which means more can go back into the product, the company, and charitable causes. Fair, transparent pricing. No hidden markups. Costs shown are estimates and may vary slightly over time.

sections.text:
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What makes BPM different from other deodorants?

BPM is a high performance natural deodorant in a recyclable metal tube. It is baking soda free, wax free, easy to apply, quick to absorb, and made to work without the usual compromises.

Does BPM actually work?

Yes. BPM was made to perform. It helps fight odour, goes on smoothly, and was refined using feedback from real people using it in everyday life.

How much should I apply?

A small amount is enough. Start with a pea sized amount for each underarm or area requiring protection, then adjust if needed.

How long does one 76g tube last?

It depends on how much you apply, but each tube contains over 300 pea-sized applications. That's roughly 5 months of daily use. Start small. A little goes a long way.

Where can I use BPM?

Anywhere odour is a concern. That includes underarms, feet, chest, back, under skin folds, behind the knees, and an unpierced navel. Just keep it to external use and avoid extra sensitive areas.
